item.title: 1939 Chevrolet VB Fire Truck at No Reserve
item.description: This 1939 Chevrolet VB fire truck was delivered on May 10, 1939, and is believed to have served a community in Nebraska before having had three owners prior to the selling dealer’s purchase in 2025. Power comes from a 216.5ci inline-six linked to a four-speed manual transmission, and equipment includes a Federal Electric siren, a ladder, and a pair of fire extinguishers. item.title: 1986 Jeep Grand Wagoneer
item.description: This 1986 Jeep Grand Wagoneer is said to have been the subject of a refurbishment under previous ownership that was completed in 2022. item.title: 2012 Aston Martin Virage Volante
item.description: This 2012 Aston Martin Virage Volante was specified in black over beige leather, and it has 43k miles following registration history in California. Power is from a 5.9-liter V12 linked to a six-speed automatic transaxle and a limited-slip differential. item.title: 1996 Daihatsu Midget II at No Reserve
item.description: This 1996 Daihatsu Midget II wears a repaint in matte silver, and it is powered by a 660cc inline-three paired with a four-speed manual transmission. Equipment includes 12" steel wheels, a bed bar, tubular bumpers, roof cross bars, auxiliary LED lights, air conditioning, a JVC head unit, and Clarion speakers. It was imported to the US in December 2025, and it shows 61k kilometers (~38k miles). This Daihatsu is now offered by the selling dealer at no reserve in California with a Virginia title.

item.title: 1966 Mercury Comet Cyclone GT Convertible 390 4-Speed
item.description: This 1966 Mercury Comet Cyclone GT convertible is refinished in red with Indianapolis 500 Pace Car graphics over a white and red interior and is powered by a 390ci V8 linked with a four-speed manual transmission. Equipment includes a beige soft top, stacked headlights, 14" Magnum 500-style wheels, bucket seats, a center console, a Hurst shifter, and headers. item.title: 3,600-Mile 2014 BMW M6 Coupe Competition Package
item.description: This 2014 BMW M6 coupe was ordered new by car collector Michael Fux, who specified the car in Sakhir Orange Metallic over Sakhir Orange Merino leather upholstery with the Competition Package. The car remained in his collection until 2019 and now has 3,600 miles. It is powered by a twin-turbocharged 4.4-liter V8 paired with a seven-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. item.title: One-Owner, 8k-Mile 2004 Honda S2000
item.description: This 2004 Honda S2000 was purchased new by the owner and has 8k miles following registration history in New Jersey. It is finished in Rio Yellow Pearl over black leather upholstery and is powered by a 2.2-liter VTEC inline-four linked to a six-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. item.title: 2000 Nissan Skyline GT-R V-Spec II
item.description: This 2000 Nissan Skyline GT-R is one of 1,855 V-Spec II examples produced and was imported to the US by the current owner in October 2025. The car is powered by a twin-turbocharged 2.6L RB26DETT inline-six that sends power to all four wheels through a six-speed manual transmission, an ATTESA E-TS PRO all-wheel-drive system, and an active limited-slip rear differential.
